_comment: Expected Devin Desktop output for canonical/simple-blocking.json. Devin Desktop uses a Claude Code-shaped format with its own tool names: event before_tool_execute -> PreToolUse, matcher 'shell' -> 'exec', timeout stays in seconds, command preserved as-is. Blocking is implicit: Devin PreToolUse hooks block on exit code 2. Devin hooks live under the 'hooks' key of ~/.config/devin/config.json or .devin/config.json, or as a bare hooks object in .devin/hooks.v1.json.
